risks.title: Hosted isolation and private storage
risks.mitigation: No real customer pilot until isolated private DB/storage, HTTPS and recovery evidence pass. Continue synthetic demo only.

risks.title: Privileged account or tenant boundary compromise
risks.mitigation: Live session/MFA and resource policies are implemented; complete independent resource/field and deployed privilege review.

risks.title: Payment reference fraud or unsafe dispatch
risks.mitigation: Counterparty receipt verification and dispatch/document gates; no bank/escrow guarantee. Verify external payment details.

risks.title: False or expired assurance claims
risks.mitigation: Separate declaration and independent review; enforce subject/crop/date scope, revoke stale claims and inspect contradictions.

risks.title: Incomplete recall reach or unsafe returned stock
risks.mitigation: Retain inventory holds and recovery controls; prove recipient completeness and operating escalation before live pilot.

risks.title: Resource overload or provider outage
risks.mitigation: Bounded reads/uploads and durable retries exist; validate representative hosted capacity and external alert ownership.

risks.title: Zero-budget hosting cannot satisfy pilot gates
risks.mitigation: No paid plan or trial assumed. Keep synthetic rehearsal until secure free resources are evidenced or founder changes budget.

risks.title: Participants rely on unsupported commercial or logistics features
risks.mitigation: Versioned limitations, external-negotiation guidance and explicit trade terms; provider marketplace remains future scope.
